query: What numeric mapping will translate posterior intervals (e.g., 90% credible bounds) into operational decisions (e.g., retrofit, reroute, monitor) for shelters?

response.query: What numeric mapping will translate posterior intervals (e.g., 90% credible bounds) into operational decisions (e.g., retrofit, reroute, monitor) for shelters?
response.answer: Numeric mapping for 90% credible bounds translates to operational decisions: retrofit if bounds exceed 80%, reroute if 70%, and monitor if below 70%.
